title: The alpha square before target-open restriction
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P with coefficient ring A [def-pur-conventions]. Let f:X→Y and g:Z→Y be separated quasi-compact locally finite-type maps, and X,Z,Y Noetherian. Let aY:Y→Spec(k) be quasi-compact and locally of finite type, V an affine open in Y, N a normalized compact-support datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], and U a Noetherian scheme. Let j:U→X and v:U→Z be separated etale maps with v≫g=j≫f. Let O⊆U be open with maps jO:O→f⁻¹V and vO:O→g⁻¹V satisfying jO≫(f⁻¹V).ι=O.ι≫j and vO≫(g⁻¹V).ι=O.ι≫v. Write fV=f|V, gV=g|V, nu for the ordinary/pro-etale comparison, and h=jO≫fV=vO≫gV. Assume further that f,g are smooth of common pure relative dimension d≥0 and compactifiable, that j,v are quasi-compact and locally of finite type, that j≫f and v≫g are compactifiable, and choose affine diagonal geometries H,K [lem-pur-affine-target-diagonal-dnc]. Let s be sourceTransport [def-pur-diagonal-etale-source-transport] and L restrictedDualizingTransport [def-pur-diagonal-etale-restricted-dualizing-transport]. For the specified alpha maps [def-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement-data], s.hom followed by vO*(alpha_g.hom) equals jO*(alpha_f.hom) followed by L.hom. This asserts only alpha compatibility and has no target-open rho or coefficient-unit comparison.

proof.text: For a single etale e:U→X with h=e≫g, put p1,p2 for the projections of X×Y X and a,b for the projections of Q=(X×Y X)×X U. The map t=sourceLift has t≫b=p1h, takes the diagonal to the base-changed section, and is etale, separated and quasi-compact. Paste the Q square with the flipped g self-product square; cancel this lower square from the h self-product square to obtain the Cartesian square (p2h,t,e,a≫p2).

Apply the proved structural_locality_baseChange helper of section-exceptional-fibre coherence to this diagram. It is the right-adjoint form of etaleAmbientLeftComparison_baseChange. Expand the outer dualizing exchange by dualizing_base_comp. Pullback composition associativity and naturality then give the ambient rectangle equation for the two self-product exchanges, locality for e, and the map through Q followed by locality for t.

Apply section_inverse_exchange_naturality along the two diagonals. Naturality and associativity of pullback composition identify its right-hand section comparison with inverse sourceOrdinary. The locality_tensorMate_congr helper identifies counit-normalized structural locality with the specified normalized tensorMate locality for every N. Cancel the inverse sourceOrdinary and locality factors to get the one-sided ordinary alpha square.

Use pullComparison_naturality to transport the ordinary square to the canonical pro-etale coordinates, cancelling the source presentation isomorphisms. Apply it to jO and vO with common h=jO≫fV. The inverse jO source comparison followed by the vO source comparison is sourceTransport. Their normalized locality comparisons compose to restrictedDualizingTransport, including the equality transport between vO≫gV and h. Cancel the common-source alpha to obtain the stated equality of morphisms.

theorem diagonalEtaleAlphaSquare (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry f aY d V)
    (K : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry g aY d V)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    [HasCompactification (j ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (v ≫ g)]
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    let s := DiagonalEtaleComparison.sourceTransport P d f g aY V H K N U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    let L := DiagonalEtaleComparison.restrictedDualizingTransport P f g aY V N U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    s.hom ≫ (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).map
        (OrientationRefinement.alpha P g aY d V K).hom =
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).map
        (OrientationRefinement.alpha P f aY d V H).hom ≫ L.hom
